notes.title: Stimuli Version 2.0 Released!
notes.notes:
Stimuli version 2.0 is here! Woohoo! 

To be honest I did not expect to be having post launch support for this game over a year and a half after its release but due to a few players inspiring me by genuinely spending time to enjoy my creation I decided to strap on the ol' boots and get a new major content update in.

This version includes many changes including
 Bug fixes having to do with getting achievements and being able to skip levels
 New platforming mechanics via the introduction of moving platforms and spikes
 Three entirely new levels including a new sequence after the final boss
 A change in how the jetpack operates, rather than giving you extra jumps it now allows you to truly fly
 More story content


Here is a gif preview of one of the new levels:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37004369/be03c521da71c7e4b54cafe273c509aee69af976.gif

Thank you for playing Stimuli, you guys are the best!

notes.title: Stimuli 1.2.1: Minor Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Stimuli 1.2.1 was just released and contains a handful of minor bug changes. Most notably:

- Bug causing hearts bar to appear in rooms they aren't supposed to was fixed
- Bug preventing player from winning game in specific scenarios was fixed
- Values such as hp and speed were tweaked on the mid-game boss to allow for better balancing

notes.title: Stimuli V 1.2: Story Update Released
notes.notes:
Today, Update 1.2: The Story Update was officially made live on Steam. This update includes major changes to the game including graphical updates, major story-mode expansions, and minor bug fixes.

Graphical Updates:
- Many of the in game sprites were updated in order to give better quality visuals and a coherent theme. This includes:
          - Update to the default ground tile texture
          - Grappling point sprite updated
          - Turret sprite updated
          - Red button sprite updated
- The final victory screen was also changed to look better
- A new explosion animation sprite was added for when to defeat the bosses

The new sprites/victory screen can be seen in the following screenshots:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37004369/d6cc736166c499e80f3b94a9ffafba2c34f2a25f.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37004369/b9dd99ae47692cf7698f5033020d230dddb9341f.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37004369/72900b302843d108b94298c1e311d57cf9f9e3c8.png

Story Mode Updates:
- Expanded the pause menu to allow for more actions
- Added a save/load feature, this does not get rid of permadeath, as any saves you have will be deleted when you die, but you can save, quit, and come back later if you need to take a break
- Added a mini boss partway through the game's story mode

notes.title: Stimuli Version 1.1 Released!
notes.notes:
Today, update 1.1, and Stimuli's first update was made live on Steam! Which includes both general bug fixes and some graphical updates!

Technical Issues Addressed:
- Bug that caused menu screen to shift slightly when buttons were pressed has been fixed
- Bug with menu music causing it to randomly start over has been fixed
- Bug with chase enemies not following has been fixed

Graphical Updates:
- Changed the default background color on all maps to a more interesting color
- Added windows revealing a space background
- Added parallax effect to backgrounds when the camera moves

Feature Changes:
- Due to issues with the LAN multiplayer not working it has been temporarily removed from the game, in favor of focusing solely on the other multiplayer modes.
- On that note, even though the game modes say Local it is possible to play fully online with your friends using Steam's Remote Play feature.
